title: On balance: итог с оговорками
description: On balance: итог с оговорками: чтение оригинального текста, контекстный словарь и точное описание ситуации с объяснениями ответов.
objectives: Найти в тексте ответ на вопрос «Какой компромисс назван?»
Различать значения balance и trade-off в теме «On balance: итог с оговорками»
notes: В предложении «The assessment is favourable on balance.» подлежащее в единственном числе согласуется с is.
При чтении важно сохранить факт или границу вывода: «It preserves that the judgement weighed competing considerations.»

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

public_payload.passage: After weighing the benefits and drawbacks, the committee described the pilot as successful on balance. A publicity draft removed the final phrase and claimed that the committee had found no drawbacks. The chair asked for it to be restored. The positive overall judgement reflected a comparison of competing considerations, not the disappearance of every disadvantage. In particular, the pilot had improved access while increasing administrative work. The committee recommended continuing it with a simpler registration process. That recommendation was compatible with both the favourable assessment and the identified problem; it did not require pretending that every part of the arrangement had worked equally well.

options.label: Less access with no administrative work.
Improved access with more administrative work.

exercises.editorial_answer: Improved access with more administrative work.
exercises.explanation: Ответ подтверждён текстом: «Improved access with more administrative work.». Другие варианты изменяют указанное обстоятельство.
